Dr. Nashir Uddin Aesthetic & Laser Centre Specialist

Dr. Mohammed Nashir Uddin is a renowned plastic and aesthetic surgeon. He passed his MBBS degree from Sir Salimullah Medical College, Dhaka in 1994 (Reg. No. A23801). Then he attained post graduate FCPS in Plastic surgery...

A passionate expert blending surgical precision with a human touch, Dr. Nashir Uddin is dedicated to pioneering innovative and patient-centric treatments in aesthetic and plastic surgery.

  • 15+ Years Of Clinical Experience.
  • Special Focus On Non-Invasive Cosmetic Procedures.
  • Personalized Patient Consultation And Care.
  • Adherence To International Safety Standards.
